about.author: Built by Hideki Kotsubo, an independent software developer based in Vancouver, Canada.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.doneText: Your account and its synced data are deleted from our servers. Your budget is still on this device, and Flowtab keeps working here without an account.
deleteAccount.notSignedIn: You're not signed in, so there's no account to delete.
deleteAccount.notOwner: Only {{owner}} can delete it, because it deletes the data for everyone in the household. Ask them, or sign out to stop syncing on this device.
deleteAccount.ownerFallback: the person who created this account

deleteAccount.thisDeviceKeeps: This device keeps its data and keeps working without an account.
deleteAccount.offline: You're offline. Deleting the account needs a connection.
